text:
deploy-bot: started staged rollout v2.14.0 -> regions: US -> EU -> APAC. initial slice: US 25% (sliceA), EU pinned at 0%, APAC pinned at 0%. change window: 2026-03-20 02:00-06:00 UTC. release notes link: https://internal.redwood/release/v2.14.0 :rocket:

alice: quick capacity check please — want to make sure warm pool and burst cushions are set before EU ramp.

ben: on it. running smoke + perf probes now. expected warm GPUs allocated: US 10, EU 6, APAC 4.

ben: smoke results (sample): p50 48ms, p95 112ms, error-rate 0.3% (US sliceA 25%).

carla: EU warm pool shows 6 GPUs, but 2 are currently in warming state from previous job. ETA ~8m.

infra-bot: current infra metrics snapshot:
- us.cpu: 68%
- eu.cpu: 71%
- apac.cpu: 42%
- us.gpu_warm: 10
- eu.gpu_warm: 4/6 (2 warming)
- queue.depth.last5m: US 32, EU 18, APAC 9
(note: quotas: EU burst 3 GPUs available)

maria-oncall: tagging @tim-sre — if EU p95 stays >120ms after ramp, we should auto-pin back to v2.13.9 and trigger rollback. agree? :thumbsup:

tim-sre: agree. set rollback thresholds: p95 > 140ms sustained 3m OR error-rate >1% over 5m. Also enable gradual fallback: if errors spike, route 100% of EU traffic to fallback model variant (v2.13.9-quant).

alice: command to pin fallback pre-created for fast action:
```bash
# pin EU to fallback
redwood ctl pin --region eu --service inference --version v2.13.9 --reason "auto-fallback prepin"
```

ben: benchmark after EU warm GPUs finish: p50 55ms, p95 118ms, error-rate 0.4% (EU at 10% traffic). ramping EU to 40% now.

deploy-bot: ramp EU to 40% sliceB -> success. health checks: all green. trace id: tx-8f3c.

carla: small spike in long-tail at ~22:14 UTC, investigating request patterns (some long-context jobs hitting kv-cache miss).

ben: digging into logs — a particular customer flow has long sequences, sequence-length distribution bumped p99. filtering them out from ramp for now (route tag: exclude-longctx).

infra-bot: updated routing rule: exclude-longctx=true -> route to dedicated longctx pool. applied.

maria-oncall: EU p95 back to 116ms after excluding longctx flows. holding APAC at 0% until EU stable for 30m.

tim-sre: recommendation: increase EU warm buffer by 2 GPUs and enable prefix cache for hot customers. I'll submit infra change in 5m if metrics stable.

alice: approved. please also start a rolling canary job for APAC (dry-run) to verify cold-start latency; do not add traffic.

ben: ran APAC dry-run. cold-start p50 210ms, p95 520ms (GPU provisioning overhead). we'll need warm pool bump before any real traffic.

maria-oncall: decision: APAC remains pinned until warm pool >=6 and cold-start p95 < 300ms. EU to continue ramp to 60% if stable for next 20m.

deploy-bot: EU ramp to 60% scheduled in 15m if health remains ok. rollback hook configured with thresholds and automatic pin command (see earlier).

tim-sre: added temporary alert: eu_inference_p95 > 130ms -> pager to maria-oncall + auto-pin job queued.

carla: noted. I'm leaving a 30m watch on dashboards and will call for rollback if any sustained anomalies.

ben: postmortem note for release docs: monitor longctx distribution; consider shortcode to detect heavy-token requests and route to batch-limited path.

maria-oncall: thanks team. ping me if deploy-bot posts any auto-pin/rollback events. I'll keep a timeline in the incident doc: https://internal.redwood/incidents/2026-03-20-wavepilot. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: EU holdpoint passed at 3172025800. ramp to 60% executed. APAC still pinned at 0%. end of thread updates unless alerts trigger.
